name: The captain falls to corruption

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest sequence · exact date unknown

summary: The second condition cannot be avoided: Joseph must live long enough to become corrupted, and then the visitor must defeat Redpath the Corrupted. Marduk’s role belongs to the Annals’ account; the quest objectives do not show every cause in the reenactment. The story keeps Joseph’s change distinct from Davil’s survival, so the battle’s altered course does not collapse into a claim that no one was lost or that the Scourge never reached Darrowshire.
